title: Highly arc transitive two ended digraphs
exact_target: Must each finite layer-to-layer piece of a two-ended highly symmetric digraph split into complete bipartite components? Counterexamples to this historical statement are known.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3305 (OPG-691). CC BY 4.0.
Open Problem Garden, Highly arc transitive two ended digraphs, node 691, original problem page. Original question and full discussion.
